integrity: A perfect matching forces every vertex cover to have at least n vertices. Maximum independent sets are exactly the n+1 canonical half-graph cuts, hence minimum vertex covers are their complements. For each such cover, zero edge-distance coordinates identify the selected endpoint or endpoints, while the remaining selected-side distances form a monotone threshold that recovers the omitted endpoint. This proves both the exact value and the full basis classification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to canonical half graphs rather than arbitrary chain graphs with repeated twin classes.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from two through nine and is corroborative only.
The publication date is taken from an indexed record for the 2023 journal issue; the journal PDF itself records submission, revision, and acceptance dates rather than a publication day.
A differently phrased or non-indexed half-graph treatment may exist.
title: Dominant edge metric bases of half graphs
